changes.title: Wendell Berry, Kentucky-born author who advocated a simpler life, has died at 92
changes.summary: Berry was a prolific writer who published more than 40 books, among them the novels "Nathan Coulter" and "A Place On Earth," the anthology "A Timbered Choir: The Sabbath Poems 1979-1997," and his farming manifesto "The Unsettling of America.".
